title: Pre-wipe GitHub backup audit and encrypted private transfer
objective: Audit the Mac workspace before it is erased and publish the important MC Plan code, local overlays, prompts and handoff state to a private encrypted GitHub release without exposing plaintext secrets.
in_scope: Reconcile every registered repository branch, commit, stash, worktree, remote reachability and untracked or ignored non-rebuildable file against the migration manifest and Git bundles.
Preserve MC-related Codex sessions and referenced attachments, workspace overlays and migration evidence while excluding authentication material and rebuildable artifacts.
Create a dedicated private GitHub backup repository, upload an AES-256 encrypted release asset plus checksums and restore metadata, and record the exact recovery route.

Run Foundation coordination and workspace validation, preserve the active MCP-F4-CORE-002 handoff lock, complete this backup workstream, integrate the Foundation documentation and push the resulting branch state to GitHub.
out_of_scope: No plaintext secret, token, production value, personal data, raw AI prompt archive or database dump may be committed to Git; the private transfer must remain encrypted at rest on GitHub.
Do not resume or close MCP-F4-CORE-002, change public contracts, deploy production, run paid providers, or claim any product milestone complete.
Do not upload Codex auth.json, browser cookies, SSH private keys, macOS keychain material, GitHub credential stores or rebuildable node_modules, build output and architecture-specific Docker images.
acceptance_evidence: Private repository https://github.com/chenfengyimei/mc-plan-private-transfer is PRIVATE and its main branch contains the recovery entrypoint.
Release pre-wipe-2026-10-20 reports the 54,596,240-byte encrypted asset as uploaded with SHA256 4ce0ae90b587cdf1df46fb25d2c1fe4195f65987a163cda089db43a775755d76.
Six Git bundles passed git bundle verify; all 1,640 files in the 54,596,210-byte plaintext archive passed manifest SHA256 verification.
Docker volumes, database snapshots, node_modules and build caches were removed from the final asset by owner direction; no GitHub re-download was requested.

direction_exception.authorized_by: Project owner, 2026-10-20: upload everything to GitHub and verify completeness because the current computer will be erased.
direction_exception.reason: One-time pre-wipe recovery work protects existing F2/F4 code, local evidence and development data without changing product scope.
